flavor.quote: Responsibility is broad and continuous. None of us are ever free of it, even if our work is unsuccessful.
flavor.author: Admiral Hyman Rickover
flavor.source: Thoughts on Man's Purpose in Life, 1974

flavor.quote: The only way of discovering the limits of the possible is to venture a little way past them into the impossible.
flavor.author: Arthur C. Clarke
flavor.source: Hazards of Prophecy, in Profiles of the Future, 1962

flavor.quote: Give me the place to stand, and I shall move the earth.
flavor.author: Archimedes
flavor.source: Pappus of Alexandria, Synagoge VIII (c. AD 340), in translation

flavor.quote: The servant glides by imperceptible approaches into the master
flavor.author: Samuel Butler
flavor.source: Erewhon, 1872, The Book of the Machines
